title: svc promotion-receipt
description: Receipt emitted by the pre-WI promotion compression gate (WI-341). One file per WI under .svc/promotion-receipts/WI-<n>.json. Schema baselined 2026-05-12 by WI-341 bootstrap.

schema_version.description: Integer schema version. Bump on any breaking change to required fields.

promoted_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the receipt was emitted.

enforced_after.description: Cutoff date (YYYY-MM-DD). WIs promoted before this date may be grandfathered. Required on every receipt; the date is set at gate-deploy time and frozen.

grandfathered.description: True only for receipts retroactively attached to WIs promoted before enforced_after. Grandfathered receipts must use decision = grandfathered and may set checks to n/a (see conditional below).

bootstrap.description: True only for WIs whose ACs implement the gate itself (chicken-and-egg). Follows WI-073 precedent. Cited inline by the source WI's Bootstrap Receipt section.

source_proposal.description: Relative path to the proposal this WI was promoted from.

concrete_contract.description: T2 check 1: every implementation AC names >=1 concrete artifact. n/a allowed only when decision=grandfathered.

tokens.description: Tokens flagged as appearing in framework-path files. Empty when result=pass.

decision.description: Promotion outcome. `accepted` = WI lands actionable. `refused` = WI does not land. `bound-to-proposal` = WI lands with Status: proposal-bound (not actionable). `grandfathered` = pre-cutoff WI.

reviewer.description: Identifier for the gate that emitted the receipt, e.g. 'validate-wi-promotion@svc' or 'capture-idea@svc'.

refusal_reason.description: Required when decision=refused. Explains which check failed and why.

allOf.comment: Grandfathered receipts must set grandfathered=true and may use n/a check values.
Non-grandfathered receipts must NOT carry grandfathered=true (only grandfathered decisions can claim the exemption).
Non-grandfathered checks must be pass/warn/fail (no n/a).
Bootstrap receipts must declare bootstrap=true; only legitimate per WI-073 precedent.
